text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …I just wanna run like I always do. C'mon… please, just… move when I want you to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her hands clasped together as if in prayer, Tamamo Cross rubs her legs in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Y-yeah! All good here. Check out these flexible legs—I'm more than ready!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No matter what happens, I'll break through. No way am I goin' out there 'n makin' a fool of myself. After all…
